title: Best Data Annotation Services (2026): Labeled Data for AI
h1: Best Data Tagging and Annotation Services
description: How to hire a data annotation service to label images, text, audio or video for AI: guidelines, quality checks, how to brief it, price drivers and red flags.
intro: Data annotation services label data so AI models can learn from it: drawing boxes around objects in images, tagging sentiment in reviews, transcribing and labeling audio, or marking events in video. The quality of labels directly limits the quality of the model. Projects go wrong when labeling rules are vague, nobody checks consistency, or sensitive data is shared without protection. This guide helps you get labels you can trust.

faq.a: Clear guidelines, trained annotators, consistency checks and a review of difficult cases.
Review a random sample yourself and ask for agreement checks, where two annotators label the same items.
Annotation tools vary by data type. Ask whether labels can be exported in the format your team needs.
Remove personal details where possible, and agree on confidentiality, access and deletion.
Usually per item, per label or per hour, depending on task difficulty.
